instr: Two figures: find out by trial and error which figure is correct. The correct figure can change without warning.
clue: Two figures appear. One of them is correct. Choose one by clicking or tapping it, or with the left/right arrow keys; you will see whether you were right. Keep choosing the correct one. Without warning, the other figure may become the correct one: then switch. Its position on screen does not matter. Press Start when ready.
